artifacts.summary: 4-phase net-deletion plan consolidating the two /todo implementations into commands/todo.md, fixing the archived_projects-blind detection bug once in the survivor, and fully deregistering skill-todo.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan deletes a file from the agent-system source store, the deletion is not complete at the source. deploy-headless.sh is additive and never removes anything, while verify-deploy Gate 13 (find_orphans) fails on any deployed-but-undeclared file. The deployed copy must be purged explicitly (rm -rf .claude/<path>) in the SAME phase as the redeploy, and that pairing forces the redeploy into the deregistration phase rather than a trailing cleanup phase -- a sub-full verification tier cannot be declared for a deregistration phase, because Gate 5 (manifest content-hash parity) and Gate 13 are exactly the surfaces no suite subset reaches.
